original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read #2979 joint rank-7 end-frame proposal and the revision-6 evidence status. Its claimed kappa is not selected. Compare coordinated changes with the losing single-change controls and locate the complete physical ledger; an aggregate moment alone does not validate the mechanism.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Prioritize a bounded independent audit of #2979: reconstruct one joint group and its single-lowering control, check the declared frames/chronology, then trace changed children, idle widths and cleanup buffers into the complete invoice and both supplier caps. Choose one still-missing implication after checking existing audits. Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.
Promoting #2979 from merged source archive to validated supplier solely from author PASS receipts or aggregate pricing.

actual_scope: Independently audit PR3605 (head 3efbb5de)'s staged 644/660 width 8->7 change against its single-change control, the unchanged PR3133 parent words: exact dirty-input identity in both orientations by two algorithms, literal inverse cleanup, chronological binary frames, local profile and helper widths, PROOF.md's prefix factorization/tables/invoice, required-failing mutants, and exact root brackets for the published PR3605 and PR3148 complete histograms with their attribution.
scope_change_reason: The card's first experiment names #2979's joint group; PR3605 is the live descendant of that joint-construction lineage (PR2979 -> PR3133 -> PR3605). Open staged-width kappa>0.00173 claims #3624/#3626/#3633/#3638/#3630 reuse its words unchanged, #3642/#3653 build RETIMED644-660 words and #3682 builds DELAYED words on top of them; all rely on author-run inherited-interpreter checks. Auditing one changed group against its single-change control is the card's method applied to the currently decision-relevant group.
bottleneck_link: Independent pricing of the supplier words that the staged-width chain inherits: a failure would invalidate the whole chain; a pass supplies the independent local check for the unchanged reusers (only the STAGED parent of the retimed #3642/#3653/#3682 words); the coverage law (inherited) already excludes mass-changing errors in the root gain, so the gain's sign is robust to owner errors moving at most 4,678 units of rank mass; but the idle repacking behind the gain moves 30,586 units, so window/journal legality and the native residual are the open risks.
stop_rule: Ship (c)+(e) with a handoff if the interpreter could not reproduce the parent control by ~75 min; stop and minimize on any identity/cleanup/profile failure; switch to p104-side-correction if another contributor claimed the words first. None triggered.
evidence: PASS_INDEPENDENT_STAGED_644_660_WORD_AUDIT (RESULT.json): both providers, parent control {1:2433,2:724,3:228,4:102,5:20,8:8} / widths 7:50,8:99 reproduced; changed words {1:2439,2:726,3:224,4:102,5:20,8:8} / widths 7:52,8:97; 632 inputs, 91 buffers; forward with dirty buffers, dual, and reverse pull-back agree; cleanup literal inverse; PROOF.md factorization P_new=P_old S1 S2 on all registers, target tables and per-register invoice exact; 19 mutants per provider behave as predicted. PASS_EXACT_MOMENT_BRACKETS (ROOT-RESULT.json): on the published histograms, PR3605 [0.001730006549538841847005,...006] and PR3148 [0.0017297774946785970118869,...870] are confirmed by two engines; delta +2.2905486024e-7. The vendored PR3605 aggregate owner witness passes the verify_aggregate.py legality checks (reimplemented) and reproduces I={1:174156,3:48334,4:1,5:10792,6:3,48:283185} with the audited widths, mass(I)=13,966,020 (windows taken as published; literal journal not re-derived). Sensitivity: both histograms meet the coverage law 72W+64N = 48,165,120 (inherited PR1012 deficit form, checked but not re-derived) and both words have per-call constant 1,856, which forces total owner capacity 54W = 35,804,160 (the witness's), so mass-changing errors (e.g. one rank-48 idle child, root shift 3.498e-7) cannot pass undetected. By linear domination with exact-interval thresholds, any mass-conserving error moving at most 4,678 units of rank mass cannot cancel the gain over PR3148 (98 rank-48->48x rank-1 relabels, 4,704 units, are the fewest that do) and any moving at most 133 units cannot take the root below 0.00173 (3 relabels are the fewest that do). PR3605 and PR3148 differ by 97,186 moved units.

open_questions.question: Do the native Gaussian phases of the paired span(429,30) entrance (rank-7 residual C_[7] tensor I_[2]) hold on all 512 columns when checked without the bw_* lineage code?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The old-entrance mutant shows the whole rank-mass saving comes from this entrance frame; every consumer (#3624/#3626/#3633/#3638/#3630/#3642/#3653/#3682) shares it, and it is certified only by the inherited native chain (also run by #3681's full wrapper replay), so independence is the open part.

open_questions.blocked_by: Understanding of the native recipe format; no data blocker.

open_questions.question: Is each live consumer's own owner journal (T450 #3624, T530 #3626, T488 #3633, T360 #3638, retimed T530/T488 #3642/#3653, retimed T360 #3682) legal, with window classes derived independently?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Where a consumer's histogram is checked against the coverage law, mass-changing owner errors are excluded, so the window bounds and literal chronology decide legality; an owner error can cancel that consumer's gain only by moving more rank mass than its own threshold, but idle repacking (30,586 units for PR3605 vs PR3148) can exceed such thresholds.
open_questions.first_step: For one consumer, derive its window classes from the source template without the retained owner.windows routine and recount its idle histogram.

open_questions.why_it_matters: PR3605's own kappa is superseded by its consumers, so this is lower priority; this package takes the witness windows as published and does not reimplement verify_aggregate.py's template-derived window-class and literal T37 order checks.
open_questions.first_step: Derive the window classes (capacity, lo, hi, bins) from the T37 source template without the retained owner.windows routine and compare with the witness's groups list.
open_questions.blocked_by: Requires the T37 source template/order format.
